entries.PRT-QL-104: In a {business}, {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period. They shared {equalSplitPercent}% of the profit equally and divided the remaining {capitalSplitPercent}% in the ratio of their capitals. If their final receipts differed by {shareDifference}, find the total profit.
entries.PRT-QL-105: A {business} ran for {totalDuration}. {partnerA} kept {capitalA} invested throughout; {partnerB} started with {initialCapitalB} but withdrew {withdrawnCapitalB} after {changeAfterB}; and {partnerC} kept {capitalC} throughout. From total profit {totalProfit}, find {targetPartner}'s share.
